hints.title: Concentric Perimeter Layers
hints.text: The grid consists of min(m, n) // 2 concentric rectangular layers that rotate independently.

hints.title: Counterclockwise Layer Extraction
hints.text: for each layer, traverse its perimeter counterclockwise to extract its elements into a 1D list.

hints.title: Modulo Shift and Writeback
hints.text: rotate the 1D list by k modulo the perimeter length, and write the shifted values back into the grid.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Extracts concentric perimeters, rotates modulo length, and reassigns in place.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rotating cell by cell k times results in O(k * M * N) steps, which times out for large k.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Unrolling each layer and rotating modulo perimeter takes O(M * N) linear time with O(M + N) layer memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should decompose 2D matrix layers into linear cyclic buffers and modulo rotation shift.
